selected_script.angle: Absurd elderly family rescuer introducing a silent rolling chair for low-level floor work
selected_script.hook: Tired of kneeling and straining your knees while cleaning floor edges?

usage_steps_used: Sit squarely on the plush center seat cushion with back against the curved backrest
Glide across smooth indoor flooring using feet to push, allowing 360-degree swivel wheels to roll smoothly

script_record.0-1.5s: Show close-up of a person's knees kneeling painfully on a hard floor while wiping a dusty baseboard, showing physical discomfort. No product visible.
script_record.1.5-3s: An absurd grandfather in a formal black tuxedo enters carrying the low-profile rolling stool (dark grey cushion/backrest, white metal frame). He sits down softly squarely on the cushion with his back against the backrest and says, 'Rest your knees!'
script_record.3-6s: The grandfather glides across the smooth indoor floor using his feet to push, the 360-degree swivel wheels rolling smoothly.
script_record.6-10s: Fast-cut scene showing the stool rolling smoothly parallel to the flat kitchen floor.
script_record.10-14s: An adult sitting squarely on the dark grey cushion, gliding next to a car tire in a flat garage, detailing the wheel effortlessly.
script_record.14-18s: A user sitting on the stool cleaning skirting boards in a bright living room, pushing with their feet to roll smoothly.
script_record.18-20s: CTA text overlay: 'Upgrade your floor comfort today.'
